sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: Synastry shows the attraction and friction between two individuals; the composite shows what the third thing they create is like to be inside. Always read both.

sections.heading: Examples
sections.body: Use these as synthesis patterns, not verdicts.

items.label: Example 1
items.body: Easy synastry, hard composite: instant Venus-Mars chemistry between them, but a composite Moon square Saturn. Read it as: the attraction is real and personal, yet the relationship itself runs heavy and reserved. Chemistry is not the same as an easy relationship.

items.label: Example 2
items.body: Hard synastry, supportive composite: their Mars-Saturn synastry is full of friction, but the composite has Sun in the 7th and a Venus trine. Read it as: they rub each other the wrong way personally, yet the bond they build is steady and partnership-oriented. Worth the friction.

items.label: Example 3
items.body: Doubled theme: Pluto-heavy synastry and a Pluto-charged composite. Intensity and transformation define both the attraction and the relationship itself; the theme is unavoidable. Take it seriously and watch for control on both levels.
